text: I had my teeth cleaned three weeks ago by a female dentist who brought her child into the room to play while the procedure was being performed. Not only did she make me wait 30 minutes, but once she started, she was very rough, prying my mouth open until it hurt. The worst part is my gums have been so sore since the cleaning, and it hasn't gone away even after three weeks. She was extremely rough.

text: I went for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal). The female dentist explained everything well and was very nice. She warned me about steps that might be slightly painful (and it was slightly painful just as she said). The staff at the counter were also very nice and polite. I have an appointment for wisdom tooth extraction soon, and I'll write another review if I get the chance.

text: My girlfriend had her tooth extracted here and it became inflamed and festering. Plus, the price is quite expensive. They only gave her a single ice pack wrapped in tissue paper to apply. So I'm confused as to how the wound could have festering.
